      Definition. Group homology and cohomology [#]

        Let be a finite group, we define two functors from the category of -modules to the category of abelian groups:

        • the left derived functors of the coinvariants functor are called the group homology ;
        • the right derived functors of the fixed point functor are called the group cohomology .

        The induced modules are always -acyclic and the coinduced modules are always -acyclic.
